methodology.mobile: Lighthouse default mobile screen and simulated throttling
methodology.desktop: 1440x960, DPR 1, simulated RTT 40 ms, throughput 10240 Kbps, CPU slowdown 1
methodology.environment: Local production renderer with gzip; not a measurement of the public Netlify deployment
methodology.indexing: SEO score is intentionally reduced by draft noindex in HTML and X-Robots-Tag. Canonical and crawlable links pass.
methodology.interpretation: Single laboratory runs vary with host load. Mobile LCP is 2.4–3.3 seconds; the 2-second mobile target is not established by these measurements. Desktop LCP is 0.6–0.9 seconds. All recorded CLS values are zero.

followUpAccessibility.finding: label-content-name-mismatch on the featured cover link
followUpAccessibility.fix: Use the linked image’s natural accessible name; remove overriding aria-label. Card links also use native content names.
followUpAccessibility.verification: Passed against the final production build: Axe label-content-name-mismatch returned no violations on the archive. The article views had no failed accessibility audits in the recorded Lighthouse runs.
